jobs.title: Senior Audit Project Manager - Payment Services
jobs.description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

The Payment Services division at U.S. Bank delivers innovative payment solutions, including credit, debit, and prepaid card issuance for consumers, businesses, and institutions. It also provides merchant authorization and settlement services. Payment Services is a dynamic and highly regulated environment requiring strong audit oversight.

The Senior Audit Project Manager within Corporate Audit Services (CAS) plays a critical role in providing independent assurance and advisory services to evaluate and improve risk management, control, and governance processes across U.S. Bancorp (USB), affiliates, and majority-owned entities. This position is dedicated to supporting the Payment Services division, ensuring robust audit coverage of its products, services, and operations.

The Senior Audit Project Manager will lead complex audit engagements focused on Payment Services, ensuring compliance with internal audit standards and regulatory requirements. This role emphasizes project management, risk assessment, and collaboration across multiple stakeholders to deliver high-quality audit results.

Primary Responsibilities

Audit Planning & Risk Assessment
Develop and maintain a risk-based audit plan for Payment Services, including identifying auditable entities, assessing risk, and determining audit cycles and resource needs for a 12–18-month horizon.
Continuously monitor emerging risks and adjust audit plans accordingly.

Audit Execution & Quality Assurance
Manage end-to-end audit projects, including planning, fieldwork, and reporting.
Review work performed by auditors to ensure accuracy, relevance, and adherence to CAS policies and IIA Standards.
Draft clear, concise audit reports that communicate findings and recommendations effectively.

Stakeholder Engagement
Build strong relationships with Payment Services leadership, risk management teams, and regulatory bodies.
Collaborate across the three lines of defense to ensure comprehensive coverage of processes, risks, and controls.

Team Leadership & Development
Provide guidance, coaching, and performance feedback to audit staff.
Support recruiting, onboarding, and professional development initiatives.

Reporting & Governance
Prepare and review reports for senior management, committees, and regulators to ensure accuracy and completeness.

Other Duties
Assist with cross-functional audit projects and special initiatives as needed.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
Typically more than 8 years of applicable experience

Preferred Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience; advanced degree or professional certification (CIA, CPA, CISA) preferred.
8+ years of audit or risk management experience, with at least 3 years in project leadership roles.
Strong knowledge of Payment Services industry risks, controls, and regulatory requirements.
Excellent communication, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing business needs.
Proven ability to build collaborative relationships across business lines and risk functions.
Thorough understanding of IIA Standards and internal control frameworks.
This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week.

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Accessibility Program Manager based in the United States.

Join a remote-first technology environment committed to making digital experiences more accessible and inclusive for people with disabilities. As a Senior Accessibility Program Manager, you will drive strategic initiatives that embed accessibility into products, workplace practices, and software development processes. You will collaborate with engineering teams, product leaders, enterprise customers, and open-source communities to improve accessibility at scale. Combining technical expertise, program leadership, and a deep understanding of assistive technologies, you will help transform accessibility goals into measurable outcomes. You will also leverage AI and automation to expand accessibility testing, strengthen internal capabilities, and accelerate the adoption of inclusive design practices. This role offers an opportunity to influence organizational strategy, empower developers with disabilities, and help build a more inclusive technology ecosystem.

Accountabilities

Drive accessibility initiatives aligned with the organization's broader accessibility strategy, contributing to improvements across workplace practices, products, customer experiences, and open-source communities.
Develop and maintain listening systems, including inclusive user research, feedback mechanisms, and engagement processes that incorporate the experiences of people with disabilities.
Build and strengthen an accessibility community of practice among enterprise customers, encouraging collaboration, knowledge sharing, and the adoption of effective accessibility standards.
Expand the capabilities of open-source accessibility scanning tools and accelerate their adoption among customers, developers, and open-source communities.
Promote accessibility throughout the software development lifecycle by involving people with disabilities in research, design, testing, and product development decisions.
Support the creation of an accessible workplace by developing internal guidance, improving accessibility resources, and contributing to inclusive procurement practices.
Apply AI and automation to improve accessibility evaluation, streamline testing processes, and scale accessibility improvements across products and services.
Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, designers, and other stakeholders to integrate accessibility requirements into product roadmaps and development priorities.
Evaluate web content and digital experiences against established accessibility standards, identify gaps, and coordinate corrective actions with relevant teams.
Develop and track performance metrics to measure accessibility progress, assess compliance, identify trends, and communicate program outcomes.
Encourage the use of modern platform capabilities and AI-powered features to strengthen internal accessibility practices and demonstrate effective implementation approaches.
Share accessibility tools, technical guidance, and best practices externally, including open-sourcing internal solutions when appropriate.
Support the availability, adoption, and improvement of assistive technologies and promote more accessible mainstream open-source projects.
Influence cross-functional stakeholders, build organizational accountability, and advocate for inclusive technology practices through clear communication and program leadership.

Requirements

At least seven years of professional experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or a related field.
Alternatively, candidates may qualify through one of the following education and experience pathways:
A bachelor's degree in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications, Marketing, or a related discipline, combined with at least five years of relevant professional experience.
A master's degree in one of these or a related fields, combined with at least three years of relevant professional experience.
A doctorate in a relevant discipline, combined with at least one year of relevant professional experience.
Equivalent practical experience demonstrating the necessary expertise and capabilities.

At least three years of experience leading programs or initiatives across organizational boundaries within a large, complex, or matrixed organization.
At least three years of experience evaluating web content and digital experiences against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).
At least one year of hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility outcomes and scale accessibility practices.
Deep understanding of accessibility principles, assistive technologies, inclusive design, and the ways people with disabilities interact with digital products and services.
Technical expertise grounded in professional experience as a software developer, designer, accessibility engineer, or in a closely related technical role.
Strong program management skills, including the ability to coordinate cross-functional initiatives, manage competing priorities, influence stakeholders, and deliver measurable results.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to translate accessibility requirements into actionable guidance for technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to collect, interpret, and use data to assess performance, identify improvement opportunities, and support compliance objectives.
A demonstrated commitment to inclusive technology and the ability to advocate for accessibility while balancing business goals, technical constraints, and user needs.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing accessible web interfaces using JavaScript and modern web technologies.
Experience establishing accessibility metrics, analyzing performance data, and monitoring compliance with relevant standards.
Familiarity with product roadmapping and experience collaborating with product management and engineering teams to incorporate accessibility features into development plans.
Experience with open-source projects, accessibility testing tools, automated evaluation, or assistive technology initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to use emerging AI capabilities to improve accessibility testing, workflows, and user experiences.
Lived experience with disability is welcomed and valued.

Additional compensation: Eligible roles may receive annual bonuses and stock-based rewards, based on individual impact and applicable compensation plans.
Remote work: Remote-first working environment, with the flexibility to work remotely within the United States.

jobs.title: IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
Търсим опитен IT Project Manager
, който да поеме водеща роля в организацията и управлението на софтуерни проекти – от планирането и проследяването на задачи, срокове и приоритети до координацията на екипите и успешното изпълнение на проектните цели.
Позицията изисква солиден практически опит в управлението на софтуерни проекти, добро познаване на Agile/Scrum процесите и умения за самостоятелно вземане на решения и справяне с възникнали предизвикателства.
Ролята включва и активно участие в работата с проектна документация, функционално тестване и контрол на качеството, както и подобряване на организацията и работните процеси.

Основни отговорности

* Планиране и управление на проектните дейности, включително разпределяне и проследяване на задачи, срокове, приоритети и зависимости.
* Проследяване и анализ на напредъка по проектите, откриване на отклонения от плана и предприемане на навременни действия за тяхното разрешаване.
* Подготовка и представяне на регулярни статуси и отчети за напредъка, текущите задачи, рисковете и приоритетите по проектите.
* Организиране и водене на екипни срещи и Scrum събития, както и участие в подобряването на Agile/Scrum практиките.
* Участие във функционалното тестване на разработените функционалности и проверка дали те отговарят на бизнес изискванията.
* Регистриране и проследяване на открити дефекти и проблеми, координиране на тяхното отстраняване и проверка на резултатите.
* Управление на комуникацията между участниците в проекта и съдействие за навременното разрешаване на възникнали въпроси, зависимости и затруднения.
* Създаване, актуализиране и поддържане на проектна и функционална документация.
* Тясна работа с разработчици и QA специалисти за добра координация на дейностите, решаване на възникнали проблеми и качествено изпълнение на функционалностите.
* Навременно откриване и управление на проектни и процесни рискове, както и предлагане и прилагане на подобрения в организацията и работните процеси.

Какво е необходимо, за да се включите

* Поне 5 години професионален опит на подобна позиция.
* Задълбочен практически опит със Scrum методологията и Agile практиките.
* Отлични умения за планиране, организиране и управление на задачи, срокове и приоритети.
* Опит с инструменти за управление на задачи и проекти (ClickUp, Jira, Trello или сходни).
* Практически опит във функционалното тестване, проверката на бизнес изисквания и работата с bug tracking системи.
* Отлични организационни, аналитични и комуникационни умения.
* Умения за самостоятелно вземане на решения, решаване на проблеми и работа с различни участници в проектите.
* Опит в координацията на технически екипи и добра комуникация с разработчици и QA специалисти.
* Висока степен на самостоятелност, инициативност и отговорност към изпълнението на проектните цели.
* Много добро владеене на английски език (писмено и говоримо).
* Уверена работа с Microsoft Office и/или Google Workspace, включително Excel и Google Sheets.

Предимства

* Scrum сертификат (PSM, CSM) или друга релевантна сертификация в управлението на проекти.
* Опит в управление на проекти за бизнес или финансов софтуер.
* Добро познаване на Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) и основните етапи в процеса по разработка на софтуер.

Придобивки за служители в компанията

* Вътрешно фирмени обучения.
* Възможност за онлайн обучения в Udemy и други платформи, както и достъп до технологична литература.
* Гъвкаво работно време.
* Възможност за хибридна работа.
* Допълнителни дни платен отпуск в зависимост от стажа във фирмата.
* Допълнителен ден отпуск за рожден ден.
* Пакет от възнаграждения, включващ годишни бонуси при добри резултати на компанията.
* Вътрешни събития в офиса и тиймбилдинги.
* Осигурени в офиса топли напитки, плодове и др.
* Допълнително здравно осигуряване.
* Психологическа грижа за екипа.

Благодарим на всички кандидати за проявения интерес. Само предварително одобрените по документи кандидати ще бъдат потърсени за обратна връзка в срок до 5 работни дни след кандидатстването.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager | AI HealthTech Startup
jobs.description:
About the Job

PhyxUp Health is looking for a Business Operations Manager to help manage and improve our day-to-day business operations across Korea and the U.S.

PhyxUp Health is a San Francisco–headquartered AI healthtech startup building an AI-powered patient care and reimbursement platform for rehabilitation providers in the U.S. Our Korea team works closely with our U.S. operations to build and scale the product.

We are already working with hospitals and clinics across the U.S., and our ARR has grown more than 10x over the past 12 months.

About PhyxUp Health

We believe some of the most important parts of healthcare happen between visits.

Patients spend far more time at home than they do in the clinic, but providers have limited visibility into what happens after the patient leaves. At the same time, clinicians spend significant time on documentation, administrative work, and reimbursement.

PhyxUp uses AI to connect the clinical visit with ongoing care. We help patients stay engaged with their treatment at home while automating repetitive clinical and reimbursement workflows for providers.

We’re not just building another healthcare software tool. We’re building the infrastructure for how care continues after the visit.

About the Role

The Business Operations Manager will help keep PhyxUp's business running smoothly as we grow across Korea and the U.S.

You'll work closely with the CEO and our U.S. team to coordinate daily operations, support our clinical and billing teams, manage administrative processes, and keep important projects moving forward.

This is a hands-on role that involves a wide range of responsibilities, from coordinating with U.S. team members and managing operational documents to supporting government programs, finance, HR, and internal projects.

As the company grows, you'll also help improve existing processes and build more efficient systems that allow our team to scale.

Your main responsibility is to make sure our day-to-day operations run smoothly and help build the systems we need as we grow.

What You'll Do

Coordinate daily operations across our Korea and U.S. teams
Support operational workflows involving our U.S. clinical team, billing team, and clinic partners
Manage internal schedules, email communication, follow-ups, and administrative tasks
Prepare and manage contracts, reports, operational documents, and company records
Coordinate applications, reporting, and administrative requirements for government support programs
Support HR and finance operations, including recruitment coordination, expense tracking, and administrative documentation
Assist with investor materials, business proposals, presentations, and due diligence documents
Track ongoing operational tasks and projects to ensure deadlines are met
Identify inefficiencies in daily operations and help develop better processes
Support the CEO and leadership team with other business operations tasks as needed

How We Work

We are an early-stage startup, which means roles are broad and individual impact is high.

Our operations span two countries and involve clinical teams, billing, customers, and external partners. Clear communication, attention to detail, and reliable execution are essential to keeping everything running smoothly.

We value people who take ownership of their work, follow through on commitments, and look for ways to improve how things are done.

We move quickly, but we don't use speed as an excuse for low-quality work. Our product is used by real healthcare providers and patients every day, so details matter.

You don't need to have all the answers from day one. But you should be willing to learn, take initiative, and become someone the team can rely on as the company grows.

What We're Looking For

Fluent in Korean and English, both written and verbal
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
Able to manage multiple tasks and prioritize work independently
Clear and professional communication with internal teams and external partners
Comfortable working with colleagues and partners in the U.S.
Proactive in identifying problems and following through on solutions
Quick to learn new tools, processes, and business workflows
Reliable, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-changing startup environment

Nice to Have

Experience in Business Operations, Administration, Executive Assistance, or a similar role
Experience working at a startup or with international teams
Experience managing government support programs, contracts, or administrative processes
Experience supporting HR, finance, or billing operations
Experience preparing business reports, presentations, or investor materials
Experience with Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, and similar collaboration tools
Interest in AI, digital health, or the U.S. healthcare industry
Prior startup experience is not required. We value people who are organized, willing to learn, and able to take ownership of their work.

Why Join PhyxUp Health

Work closely with the CEO and leadership team of a growing AI healthtech startup
Gain hands-on experience in both Korean and U.S. business operations
Work with U.S. healthcare organizations and international partners
Gain exposure to clinical operations, billing, finance, HR, and startup management
Help build and improve the operational systems of a growing company
Take on increasing responsibility as the company expands
Have a direct impact on how the company operates and grows

Location

Seoul, South Korea (122, Mapo-daero, Mapo-gu)

Compensation

Negotiable based on experience and qualifications.

Hiring Process

Application → Take-home Assignment → 1st Interview → 2nd Interview → Reference Check

If you enjoy organizing complex operations, taking ownership of your work, and helping a growing startup run more efficiently, we'd love to hear from you.

Functieomschrijving

Ben jij een ervaren projectmanager die impact wil maken binnen een snelgroeiend softwarebedrijf? Wil jij het verschil maken bij klanten op het gebied van personeelsplanning en personeelskrapte? Heb jij de kennis en vaardigheden om projecten efficiënt te managen en tegelijkertijd de klanttevredenheid hoog te houden? Wil jij jouw ervaring inzetten om het team te versterken en samen optimale resultaten te behalen? Dan kijken we ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten!
Werken bij een van de Top 3 spelers in Workforce management in Nederland en bijdragen aan snelle ontwikkeling in het buitenland?

Bij Intus helpen wij onze klanten en hun medewerkers met slimmer plannen. Hierdoor dragen we bij aan het oplossen van één van de belangrijkste maatschappelijke uitdagingen: personeelskrapte.
Onze producten brengen flexibiliteit en efficiëntie in het planningsproces en dat is fijn voor iedereen. Onze klanten kunnen onze medewerkers optimaal inzetten, terwijl we tegelijkertijd bijdragen aan meer werkgeluk en een gezonde werk-privé balans. Een win-win voor iedereen!

Als projectmanager
bij Intus speel je een cruciale rol in projecten bij onze diverse klanten in verschillende markten zoals zorg, overheid, industrie en logistiek
. Je structureert en realiseert meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd van begin tot het eind. Dit kan gaan om het begeleiden van onze klanten bij het volledig implementeren van onze software InPlanning bij een nieuwe klant of het begeleiden van een complexe transformatie in het applicatielandschap bij een bestaande klant. Ook interne projecten kunnen onderdeel van de werkzaamheden zijn. Dankzij jouw vermogen om draagvlak te creëren en overzicht te behouden, help je klanten en zorg je voor een efficiënt verloop van de projecten.

Je maakt deel uit van een team van projectmanagers en consultants die verantwoordelijk zijn voor alle projecten in Nederland. Als projectmanager ben jij tijdens een project hét aanspreekpunt voor de klant, met betrekking tot de voortgang, planning, kwaliteit, budget en uitvoering. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s (o.a. implementatie consultants en technisch consultants) om de projecten te realiseren, en daarnaast heb je ook regelmatig contact met je collega-projectmanagers, accountmanagers, technisch consultants en product owners. Kortom, een boeiende functie in een dynamische werkomgeving!

Als projectmanager begeleidt je projecten van A tot Z wat betekent dat je de volgende verantwoordelijkheden hebt:

Opstellen van een Plan van Aanpak en een implementatieagenda.
Plannen van projectwerkzaamheden van consultants.
Zorgdragen voor een goede samenwerking tussen alle interne en externe stakeholders van het project.
Tijdig signaleren en rapporteren van risico's, op basis waarvan je een concrete aanpak voorstelt op basis waarvan besluitvorming kan plaatsvinden.
Bewaken van kaders waaronder projectdoelen, kwaliteit, budgetten en planningen.
Verzorgen van maandrapportages en voorbereiding van de facturatie richting de klant.
Overzicht behouden over meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt uitgebreide werkervaring als projectmanager, bij voorkeur in de gezondheidszorg.
Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding.
Je hebt een pro-actieve werkhouding en neemt verantwoordelijkheid.
Je bent een echte teamspeler en weet hoe je effectief stakeholders kunt betrekken.
Je werkt gestructureerd en hebt een helikopterview.
Je bent resultaatgericht, maar verliest de kwaliteit niet uit het oog.
Je bent gedreven, slim, analytisch en bent in staat op verschillende niveaus te denken en te handelen.
Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal op professioneel niveau, mondeling en schriftelijk. Beheers je daarnaast ook nog Duits? Dan is dat de kers op de taart!

Bij Intus hechten we veel waarde aan een informele, maar professionele werksfeer. Maar er is meer dat ons bijzonder maakt! Hier is ons DNA in een kort overzicht:

Trots;
op ons product, onze klanten én onze collega’s!
Goede vibe;
een gezellige sfeer waar iedere mening telt.
Open cultuur;
jazeker, met korte lijnen en weinig hiërarchie.
Collegialiteit;
we helpen elkaar en hebben lol met elkaar. Heb je een last-minute vraag? Je vindt altijd iemand die wil helpen.
Ambitieus;
w at we tot nu toe hebben gedaan is geweldig, maar we zijn nog lang niet klaar!

Een goed salaris
Een zinvolle baan
: deel uitmaken van een organisatie die het werkleven van 200.000 mensen gemakkelijker maakt
Gratis lunch en fruit

About Role:

Campaign Strategy Analyst owning campaign and brand insights for assigned brands and markets within Commercial AIDE (Analytics, Insights & Data Exploration). The role delivers decision-ready, data-driven insights and actionable recommendations that brand managers and account managers use in client discussions, planning cycles, and optimization. The analyst also plays a critical role in KPI design and measurement strategy, including feasibility assessments for contractual KPIs and alignment to Docquity's internal insights metrics.

Job Description:

Insight Generation & Performance Diagnosis: Analyze campaign and brand performance to uncover trends, drivers, and opportunities across audiences, content, channels, and time.
Develop structured diagnostic deep-dives (e.g., funnel conversion, cohort movement, segment differences, market variance) to explain the “why” behind performance.
Translate analysis into concise insight narratives (what happened, why it happened, implications) with supporting evidence and clear assumptions.
Actionable Recommendations & Optimization: Convert insights into prioritized recommendations with clear levers, expected impact direction, dependencies, and how success will be measured.
Support optimization decisions (targeting, content strategy, channel mix, cadence, audience prioritization) based on observed drivers and constraints.
Propose lightweight forward-looking views (e.g., pacing vs target, scenario comparisons) that improve planning and decision clarity.
KPI Building, Measurement Strategy & Contract Feasibility: Lead KPI framework design for campaigns — define KPI trees, metric definitions, calculation logic, targets/benchmarks, and interpretation guidance.
Assess feasibility of proposed contractual KPIs and deliverables by validating data availability, required instrumentation, methodological soundness, and operational effort.
Recommend feasible KPI alternatives or phased measurement approaches when data limitations exist, ensuring alignment with Docquity's internal insights metrics standards.
Partner with Data & Platform and Product Insights to validate data readiness, resolve definition gaps, and document KPI logic for consistent reuse.
Stakeholder Partnership & Enablement: Provide brand and account managers with insight-ready charts, talking points, and recommendations for client-facing materials (the account/brand team owns final review delivery).
Join working sessions and (as needed) client calls as the insights subject-matter resource to clarify methodology, confidence, and trade-offs.
Standardize and improve recurring insight outputs (templates, metric dictionaries, playbooks) to reduce ambiguity and speed up decision cycles.
Feedback Loop Into a Scalable Product: Identify recurring questions and high-value analyses to productize into scalable modules in partnership with Product Insights.
Lead commercial product creation by translating recurring client and internal insight needs into scalable analytics products, reusable modules, and packaged solution offerings, in close partnership with Product Insights and commercial stakeholders.
Flag data quality issues, missing fields, and pipeline gaps to Data & Platform, and support validation of fixes through reproducible checks.
Contribute to continuous improvement by documenting learnings, best practices, and reusable analyses across brands and markets.

Experience/ Skills Required:

5 years of experience in analytics/BI, performance marketing analytics, commercial strategy analytics, or consulting (healthcare/pharma experience is a plus).
Strong SQL proficiency; comfortable working with large datasets and turning business questions into analysis plans. Experience in Python, R, and other programming languages is a plus.
Experience with visualization and reporting tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar).
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to translate analyses into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience designing KPIs/measurement frameworks; familiarity with experimentation, cohort analysis, and segmentation is advantageous.
Proven track record in commercial product creation and productization, with the ability to shape analytics capabilities into scalable, high-value client-facing and internal commercial solutions.
Strong proficiency in applying AI to business and commercial use cases to elevate analysis, insight generation, workflow automation, and decision support, with sound judgment on data quality, governance, and responsible adoption.
Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment; willingness to collaborate across time zones.

While we have been growing fast, we are still small enough that everyone makes a pivotal difference. We care less about hours worked and more about the outcome — and the impact you make. We have worked hard to create an autonomous working culture emphasizing work/life balance and a fun working environment. We follow the hybrid work culture.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Department:
IT
Location:
London
Compensation:
£45,000 - £55,000 / year

Description

The Business Analyst is a trusted partner to senior leadership, aligned to a specific area of the business and embedded within it. Working side by side with the Managing Director and Commercial Director day to day, their core purpose is to understand how the area really works and to find and unlock opportunities across people, process and systems.

This is a business improvement role at heart, with a remit that reaches well beyond IT. Many of the biggest opportunities lie in the way work is organised and carried out day to day, how teams are structured, how processes flow, and how effort is spent and often have little to do with technology. The Business Analyst is there to spot those opportunities, make the case for change, and help deliver measurable benefits.

Where an opportunity does call for technology, the Business Analyst is also the route into IT, capturing and shaping the requirement and taking it to the relevant Product Owner and delivery team, so nothing is lost between the business and delivery. The role sits within the business area and works to its leadership, while keeping a close, joined-up link with IT and Product Owners.

The Business Analyst also works directly with clients to support the delivery of our contracts and helps coordinate and manage work with third-party suppliers and partners. It calls for someone as comfortable in a boardroom conversation about commercial strategy as they are mapping a process or shaping a requirement.

Key Responsibilities

Partnering with Leadership & Clients
Work side by side with the Managing Director and Commercial Director day to day, as part of their team and a dependable point of contact for improvement and change.
Translate strategic and commercial objectives into practical, deliverable pieces of work.
Work directly with clients to support the delivery of our contracts, understanding their requirements and representing their needs within the business.
Build strong, trusted relationships at every level — from front-line operational teams to executive leadership, and externally with clients and contract partners.
Facilitate workshops, interviews, and working sessions to draw out needs, resolve conflicting priorities, and build consensus.
Communicate clearly and confidently, tailoring the message to the audience — from detailed working documents to concise executive summaries.

Identifying Opportunity across People, Process & Systems
Take time to understand how the area operates end to end, building a clear picture of where value is created and where it is lost.
Proactively identify opportunities to improve, looking through three lenses:

People
- how teams are organised; where capability, capacity, roles, or ways of working could be strengthened; and where effort is duplicated or misdirected.
Process
- where processes are inefficient, inconsistent, manual, or carry unnecessary risk, and how they could be simplified or redesigned.
Systems
- where better use of existing systems and data, or new technology, could remove friction, save time, or unlock growth.

Build the case for change - quantifying the benefit, the effort, and the priority so leadership can make informed decisions.
Recognise that many of the best opportunities are non-technical, and pursue improvement wherever the value lies, not only where a system is involved.

Business Process Improvement
Analyse current (“as-is”) processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
Design and document improved (“to-be”) ways of working that deliver measurable benefit.
Produce clear process maps, procedures, and supporting documentation.
Support the implementation of process changes, ensuring they are understood, adopted, and embedded across the business.
Track and measure the impact of process changes against agreed outcomes.

Requirements & the Route into IT
When a business need calls for technology, act as the route into IT and systems delivery — the first point of contact for capturing what the area needs.
Elicit, analyse, challenge, and prioritise requirements from stakeholders across multiple functions.
Distinguish clearly between business needs, user requirements, and solution constraints
Translate requirements into clear, well-formed inputs for Product Owners, maintaining traceability from business objective through to delivered outcome, so nothing is lost between the business and delivery teams.

Managing Work with Third Parties
Help coordinate and manage work with third-party suppliers, vendors, and contract partners.
Ensure external work is clearly scoped, aligned to business priorities, and delivering the intended value.
Act as a joined-up point of contact between the business, IT, and third parties, keeping activity visible and on track.

System Rollouts & Business Change
Support the rollout and implementation of new systems and solutions across the organisation.
Assess the impact of change on people, processes, and ways of working.
Develop and support change and adoption activity, including communications, training material, and readiness assessments.
Help teams transition smoothly through change, managing resistance and building buy-in.
Ensure the business is prepared, supported, and confident ahead of any go-live.

User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
Plan, coordinate, and support UAT for new and changed systems.
Develop test scenarios and acceptance criteria based on documented requirements.
Work with business users to execute testing and validate that solutions meet the agreed need.
Ensure sign-off criteria are clear, met, and evidenced before go-live.

Defect & Issue Management
Log, triage, and prioritise defects raised during testing and after implementation.
Investigate issues, gather supporting detail, and clearly articulate the impact to delivery teams.
Manage defects through to resolution, tracking status and keeping stakeholders informed.
Distinguish between defects, change requests, and user error, routing each appropriately.

Governance, Documentation & Reporting
Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation across opportunities, processes, requirements, and change activity.
Provide clear, timely progress updates and reporting to leadership.
Support the prioritisation of work in line with commercial, operational, and contractual priorities.
Ensure work is delivered in line with relevant governance, standards, and controls.

Key Relationships
Internal
- Managing Director and Commercial Director (day-to-day leadership); operational and commercial teams; IT Product Owners and delivery teams; business change and support functions.
External
- Clients and contract partners; third-party suppliers and system vendors.

Scope & Dimensions
Aligned to a specific area of the business, operating across its functions and contracts.
Works independently, managing own workload and competing priorities.
Influences without direct authority, relying on credibility, communication, and stakeholder management.
Contributes directly to the performance, efficiency, and improvement of the area and its contracts.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

Essential
Proven experience in a Business Analyst role, ideally within an operational or commercially driven environment.
A track record of identifying and delivering improvement across people, process and systems - not solely technology change.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence and credibility to work directly with senior leadership and with clients.
Experience working directly with clients to support the delivery of contracts.
Strong process analysis and mapping capability (as-is / to-be).
Excellent requirements gathering, elicitation, and documentation skills.
Experience supporting business change, system rollouts, and adoption activity.
Experience planning and supporting user acceptance testing.
Experience managing defects and issues through to resolution.
Experience coordinating or managing work with third-party suppliers or partners.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate between business and technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-moving environment.

Desirable
Experience delivering measurable process improvement and efficiency benefits.
Experience working alongside Product Owners and Agile delivery teams.
Experience in a relevant sector (e.g. utilities, infrastructure, construction, services).
Familiarity with business analysis and change frameworks and methodologies.
Experience with tooling such as process mapping software, requirements/backlog tools, and reporting/BI tools.

Qualifications
A Level 4 Business Analyst qualification, or equivalent, is required for this role.
Individuals in existing roles who do not yet hold this qualification will be supported by Network Plus to complete it.

Personal Attributes & Behaviours
Commercially aware - understands the wider business context and the drivers behind change.
Curious - asks the right questions to get beneath the surface of a problem and spot opportunity.
Credible and confident - able to hold their own with senior stakeholders and challenge constructively.
Pragmatic - balances the ideal solution with what is deliverable and beneficial.
Collaborative - builds strong working relationships and brings people with them.
Organised - manages competing priorities calmly and delivers to commitments.
Adaptable - comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities.

What Success Looks Like
Leadership sees the Business Analyst as a trusted, go-to partner for improvement and change.
Opportunities across people, process and systems are identified, quantified, and turned into measurable benefit.
Business and client needs are captured clearly and translated cleanly into delivery, with minimal loss or rework.
Process changes and system rollouts land smoothly, with strong adoption and measurable benefit.
New systems are tested thoroughly, and defects are managed proactively and transparently.
Work with third parties is well coordinated and delivers value.
Leadership and clients have clear visibility of activity, progress, and outcomes.

Job Benefits

We offer a competitive salary based on experience along with a full benefits package. This role will also come with a car allowance.

The Facade Project Manager will take full responsibility for the end-to-end delivery of doors, windows, and facade projects across the UAE, from contract handover through to project completion and final handover.
The role involves overseeing project schedules, quality, costs, HSE, and team management, while coordinating with clients (developer and/or main contractors), consultants, and suppliers to ensure contractual compliance and on-time project delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

1. End-to-End Project Management

Lead the entire project lifecycle, from contract handover, shop drawing development, material procurement, factory production, cross-border transportation, and on-site installation through to final inspection, project handover, and defects liability/maintenance.
Take overall accountability for project execution and contractual performance.

2. Planning and Team Management

Develop and manage the master construction programme, monthly schedules, and weekly work plans, monitoring progress against targets and implementing corrective measures where necessary.
Manage site engineers, supervisors, foremen, and installation teams, ensuring effective resource allocation and execution of assigned tasks.

3. Technical and Quality Management

Review and approve shop drawings, material submittals, and method statements.
Follow up on material approvals, Material Inspection Requests (MIRs), Work Inspection Requests (WIRs), site material inspections, and performance testing.
Manage Requests for Information (RFIs), ensure timely closure of Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and oversee the rectification and closure of snag lists to achieve successful inspections and acceptance.

4. Site Safety and Regulatory Compliance

Take overall responsibility for on-site HSE management.
Ensure compliance with applicable UAE municipal regulations, relevant Occupational Health and Safety Standards, and client-specific HSE requirements.
Identify and mitigate site safety risks and maintain good housekeeping and safe working practices.

5. Commercial and Final Account Management

Verify project quantities and follow up on Progress Payment Claim and Payment Certificates.
Lead technical and commercial discussions relating to Variation Orders (VOs) and Change Orders (COs), including quantity calculations and commercial follow-up.
Work closely with the commercial team to manage project costs and complete final account settlements.

6. Stakeholder Coordination

Liaise with main contractors, consultants, clients, and suppliers to resolve site technical conflicts, coordinate construction schedules, and manage interface issues with other trades.

7. Inspection, Completion, and Handover

Coordinate final inspections, project completion and acceptance, outstanding defect rectification, and formal handover.
Ensure all handover documentation is complete, compliant, and meets client and relevant municipal authority requirements.

8. Reporting and Risk Management

Provide regular reports to senior management on project progress, costs, quality, and key risks.
Proactively identify schedule, cost, and quality risks and develop appropriate mitigation plans.

Requirements:

1. Education and Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or above in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
Dubai Municipality (DM) or Abu Dhabi Department of Municipalities and Transport (DMT) registered engineer status is preferred.

2. Professional Experience

At least 5 years of full-time project management experience in the doors, windows, and facade industry.
Proven project delivery experience across multiple facade systems, including:

-Unitized Curtain Wall Systems

-Aluminium Cladding
-Aluminium Alloy Windows and Doors
-Glass Fibre Reinforced Concrete (GRC)
At least 3 years of on-site facade project management experience in the UAE or wider GCC region.
Experience with high-rise residential buildings, commercial complexes, or super-high-rise developments is preferred.
Familiarity with FIDIC construction contract conditions, with practical experience in variation negotiations, claims management, and project final accounts.

3. Technical Competencies

Strong knowledge of facade installation methods, technical drawings, specifications, material standards, and project inspection and acceptance procedures in the Middle East.
Familiarity with UAE construction regulations, municipal approval requirements, and site HSE management systems.
Ability to independently review shop drawings, method statements, and material submittal documents.

Leader français de l’assurance auto en ligne depuis 1992, Direct Assurance, entité du Groupe AXA, propose également des offres d’assurance habitation, moto et santé.

Aujourd'hui, plus de deux millions de clients nous font confiance
grâce à un tarif adapté et une gestion des sinistres personnalisée.

Nous faisons de l'expérience client une priorité
en mettant à disposition une gamme de produits simple, claire et performante.

Si vous recherchez un environnement convivial, dynamique, digital et tourné vers l'innovation, au sein d'une entreprise en croissance, rejoignez-nous !

Vous allez aimer grandir à nos côtés.

Vous allez aimer innover avec nous.

Vous allez aimer que nos clients nous adorent.

VOTRE RÔLE ET VOS MISSIONS

Au sein du pôle Pilotage de flux, Data et Outil de la relation client, vous serez rattaché au Responsable opérations analytics commercial & sinistres dans une équipe de 5 collaborateurs.

Votre mission principale sera de guider les prises de décisions en matière d'optimisation des parcours client, d'amélioration de la productivité et suivi de la performance, tout en soutenant la croissance et optimisant la productivité de nos call centers en lien avec le plan stratégique de l'entreprise.

Votre expertise technique Databricks combinée à la compréhension de l'environnement opérationnel, des process et de nos outils de la relation client sera clé pour réaliser des analyses pertinentes et fiables, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers et data.

Vous occuperez également le rôle de référent technique Databricks de l'équipe, accompagnant la migration vers Unity Catalog, l'évolution des pipelines et les bonnes pratiques de développement.

Vos missions :

Mise en place de reporting de pilotage

Sécuriser l’environnement reporting existant
Assurer le suivi de production des indicateurs au quotidien
Accompagner la mise en place de nouveaux indicateurs pertinents du suivi opérationnel en collaboration avec les sites opérationnels et les équipes métiers
Enrichir l’environnement existant dans le respect des standards de programmation

Analyse de la performance opérationnelle

Accompagner la forte croissance de Direct Assurance, notamment avec la croissance des effectifs, la croissance de site opérationnel pour en anticiper et comprendre les effets.
Contribuer aux analyses permettant d’améliorer les performances des équipes opérationnelles
Identifier les axes d’amélioration et les drivers de sous/ sur performance afin d’aider les équipes à construire leur plan d’actions.

Accompagnement des projets d’entreprise

Travailler en collaboration étroite avec les experts métier pour comprendre les problématiques opérationnelles et traduire les enjeux métier en suivi data ;
Accompagner la transformation de la Relation Client avec les enjeux d’IA
Définir et suivre les indicateurs de succès et anticiper les risques, notamment dans la cadre de notre stratégie de contact ;
Formaliser des scenarii de décision et des préconisations pour faciliter la prise de décision ;

R
éférent technique Data

Être le point focal technique sur les sujets Databricks, pipeline engineering et bonnes pratiques DevOps de l'équipe
Piloter la migration des notebook Databricks vers Unity Catalog : définir la stratégie, planifier les étapes, valider la conformité et les performances
Établir et maintenir les standards de développement des pipelines (code review, testing, documentation, versioning)
Supporter et former l'équipe aux nouvelles technologies et pratiques post-migration
Anticiper les risques techniques et proposer des solutions d'optimisation et de scalabilité

VOTRE PROFIL

Vous êtes un professionnel passionné par la data
, avec au moins 5 ans d'expérience, idéalement dans le conseil en management des organisations et des systèmes d’information.

Vos compétences analytiques, organisationnelles et votre approche pragmatique sont des atouts précieux.

Votre aisance relationnelle pour échanger régulièrement avec d’autres équipes (techniques ou non techniques) et fructifier concrètement chacun de ces échanges sont essentiels.

Vous avez des compétences techniques en :

Python, Pyspark, SQL
Expertise confirmée avec Databricks (pipelines, Unity Catalog)
Expérience avec DevOps et CI/CD
Expérience avec Versioning (Git) et code review
Connaissance d’un outil de visualisation (PowerBi, tableau, ...)

Une connaissance du secteur de l’assurance
serait un plus.

Des déplacements ponctuels en France ou à l’étranger seront à prévoir.

Le poste est basé à Suresnes (92) à proximité de la Défense.

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?

Nous sommes persuadés que pour bien prendre soin de nos clients, nous devons commencer par bien prendre soin de nos collaborateurs ! Les avantages que nous proposons à nos salariés sont nombreux.

Nous choisir, c’est bénéficier :

D’un package de rémunération complet comprenant un salaire fixe, un complément de rémunération variable, des primes, de la participation et de l’intéressement, la possibilité d’acquérir des actions AXA, ou encore des solutions d’épargne avantageuses ;
D’un cadre de travail flexible jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail possible par semaine (selon profil du poste), des tickets restaurant pour les jours télétravaillés ou encore une participation à l’achat d’un écran ou fauteuil ergonomique ;
D’une politique visant à concilier vie personnelle et vie professionnelle avec 28 jours de congés payés, entre 14 et 16 RTT selon les années, des formules de travail à temps partiel ou encore des jours d’absence rémunérées pour la rentrée scolaire ou un déménagement par exemple ;
De la possibilité de s’engager pour une cause qui vous tient à cœur grâce à nos associations telles que AXA Atout Cœur, AXA Compétences Solidaires ou encore AXA Prévention ;

Et bien plus encore ! Perspectives de développement des compétences et de carrières immenses, CE, conciergerie, offres privilèges, soutien en cas d’épreuve personnelle…On s’arrête là, la liste est longue

En lien avec nos engagements, nous célébrons chaque arrivée en agissant en faveur de la reforestation mondiale : nous plantons un arbre pour chaque recrutement.

Alors, prêt à postuler ?

VOTRE ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL

Notre raison d’être chez AXA ? Chaque jour, nous agissons ensemble pour le progrès humain en protégeant ce qui compte dans + de 50 pays. Accompagner près de 95 millions de clients à chaque étape de leur vie, une mission qui donne le sourire et envie de se lever le matin à nos employés et agents (+ de 145 000 dans le monde !).

Chez AXA, nous sommes riches de nos singularités et accueillons tous les profils dans leur diversité. Au-delà de mener une politique inclusive engagée, nous agissons au quotidien en tant qu’employeur citoyen et responsable pour des causes sociétales & environnementales.

Ces ambitions vous parlent ? Alors rejoignez un des leaders de l’assurance et venez changer le monde avec nous !

Nous proposons des parcours de développement professionnel en adéquation avec la transformation digitale du secteur de l’assurance pour enrichir votre panel de compétences.
Nous avons à cœur de célébrer nos réussites. La convivialité qui nous anime est le fruit de la diversité des profils que nous recrutons.
Nous disposons de multiples avantages (congés, temps partiel, télétravail, etc.)
Nos locaux proposent un cadre de travail moderne avec une mise à disposition d’espaces de détente (baby-foot, cafétéria) et de services (espace forme, places en crèche…) pour une Expérience Collaborateur réussie !
Nous nous engageons en faveur de la lutte contre les discriminations et soutenons la diversité et l'égalité des chances. Tous nos emplois sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Si ce poste vous intéresse et si la perspective de contribuer fortement au développement de l’entreprise dans un environnement innovant et dynamique vous motive, rejoignez-nous !

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Accessibility Program Manager based in the United States.

Join a remote-first technology environment committed to making digital experiences more accessible and inclusive for people with disabilities. As a Senior Accessibility Program Manager, you will drive strategic initiatives that embed accessibility into products, workplace practices, and software development processes. You will collaborate with engineering teams, product leaders, enterprise customers, and open-source communities to improve accessibility at scale. Combining technical expertise, program leadership, and a deep understanding of assistive technologies, you will help transform accessibility goals into measurable outcomes. You will also leverage AI and automation to expand accessibility testing, strengthen internal capabilities, and accelerate the adoption of inclusive design practices. This role offers an opportunity to influence organizational strategy, empower developers with disabilities, and help build a more inclusive technology ecosystem.

Accountabilities

Drive accessibility initiatives aligned with the organization's broader accessibility strategy, contributing to improvements across workplace practices, products, customer experiences, and open-source communities.
Develop and maintain listening systems, including inclusive user research, feedback mechanisms, and engagement processes that incorporate the experiences of people with disabilities.
Build and strengthen an accessibility community of practice among enterprise customers, encouraging collaboration, knowledge sharing, and the adoption of effective accessibility standards.
Expand the capabilities of open-source accessibility scanning tools and accelerate their adoption among customers, developers, and open-source communities.
Promote accessibility throughout the software development lifecycle by involving people with disabilities in research, design, testing, and product development decisions.
Support the creation of an accessible workplace by developing internal guidance, improving accessibility resources, and contributing to inclusive procurement practices.
Apply AI and automation to improve accessibility evaluation, streamline testing processes, and scale accessibility improvements across products and services.
Collaborate with product managers, software engineers, designers, and other stakeholders to integrate accessibility requirements into product roadmaps and development priorities.
Evaluate web content and digital experiences against established accessibility standards, identify gaps, and coordinate corrective actions with relevant teams.
Develop and track performance metrics to measure accessibility progress, assess compliance, identify trends, and communicate program outcomes.
Encourage the use of modern platform capabilities and AI-powered features to strengthen internal accessibility practices and demonstrate effective implementation approaches.
Share accessibility tools, technical guidance, and best practices externally, including open-sourcing internal solutions when appropriate.
Support the availability, adoption, and improvement of assistive technologies and promote more accessible mainstream open-source projects.
Influence cross-functional stakeholders, build organizational accountability, and advocate for inclusive technology practices through clear communication and program leadership.

Requirements

At least seven years of professional experience in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR), sustainability, accessibility engineering and design, or a related field.
Alternatively, candidates may qualify through one of the following education and experience pathways:
A bachelor's degree in Business, Sustainability, Computer Science, Communications, Marketing, or a related discipline, combined with at least five years of relevant professional experience.
A master's degree in one of these or a related fields, combined with at least three years of relevant professional experience.
A doctorate in a relevant discipline, combined with at least one year of relevant professional experience.
Equivalent practical experience demonstrating the necessary expertise and capabilities.

At least three years of experience leading programs or initiatives across organizational boundaries within a large, complex, or matrixed organization.
At least three years of experience evaluating web content and digital experiences against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).
At least one year of hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve accessibility outcomes and scale accessibility practices.
Deep understanding of accessibility principles, assistive technologies, inclusive design, and the ways people with disabilities interact with digital products and services.
Technical expertise grounded in professional experience as a software developer, designer, accessibility engineer, or in a closely related technical role.
Strong program management skills, including the ability to coordinate cross-functional initiatives, manage competing priorities, influence stakeholders, and deliver measurable results.
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to translate accessibility requirements into actionable guidance for technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to collect, interpret, and use data to assess performance, identify improvement opportunities, and support compliance objectives.
A demonstrated commitment to inclusive technology and the ability to advocate for accessibility while balancing business goals, technical constraints, and user needs.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing accessible web interfaces using JavaScript and modern web technologies.
Experience establishing accessibility metrics, analyzing performance data, and monitoring compliance with relevant standards.
Familiarity with product roadmapping and experience collaborating with product management and engineering teams to incorporate accessibility features into development plans.
Experience with open-source projects, accessibility testing tools, automated evaluation, or assistive technology initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to use emerging AI capabilities to improve accessibility testing, workflows, and user experiences.
Lived experience with disability is welcomed and valued.

Additional compensation: Eligible roles may receive annual bonuses and stock-based rewards, based on individual impact and applicable compensation plans.

Позицията изисква солиден практически опит в управлението на софтуерни проекти, добро познаване на Agile/Scrum процесите и умения за самостоятелно вземане на решения и справяне с възникнали предизвикателства.
Ролята включва и активно участие в работата с проектна документация, функционално тестване и контрол на качеството, както и подобряване на организацията и работните процеси.

Основни отговорности

* Планиране и управление на проектните дейности, включително разпределяне и проследяване на задачи, срокове, приоритети и зависимости.
* Проследяване и анализ на напредъка по проектите, откриване на отклонения от плана и предприемане на навременни действия за тяхното разрешаване.
* Подготовка и представяне на регулярни статуси и отчети за напредъка, текущите задачи, рисковете и приоритетите по проектите.
* Организиране и водене на екипни срещи и Scrum събития, както и участие в подобряването на Agile/Scrum практиките.
* Участие във функционалното тестване на разработените функционалности и проверка дали те отговарят на бизнес изискванията.
* Регистриране и проследяване на открити дефекти и проблеми, координиране на тяхното отстраняване и проверка на резултатите.
* Управление на комуникацията между участниците в проекта и съдействие за навременното разрешаване на възникнали въпроси, зависимости и затруднения.
* Създаване, актуализиране и поддържане на проектна и функционална документация.
* Тясна работа с разработчици и QA специалисти за добра координация на дейностите, решаване на възникнали проблеми и качествено изпълнение на функционалностите.
* Навременно откриване и управление на проектни и процесни рискове, както и предлагане и прилагане на подобрения в организацията и работните процеси.

Какво е необходимо, за да се включите

* Поне 5 години професионален опит на подобна позиция.
* Задълбочен практически опит със Scrum методологията и Agile практиките.
* Отлични умения за планиране, организиране и управление на задачи, срокове и приоритети.
* Опит с инструменти за управление на задачи и проекти (ClickUp, Jira, Trello или сходни).
* Практически опит във функционалното тестване, проверката на бизнес изисквания и работата с bug tracking системи.
* Отлични организационни, аналитични и комуникационни умения.
* Умения за самостоятелно вземане на решения, решаване на проблеми и работа с различни участници в проектите.
* Опит в координацията на технически екипи и добра комуникация с разработчици и QA специалисти.
* Висока степен на самостоятелност, инициативност и отговорност към изпълнението на проектните цели.
* Много добро владеене на английски език (писмено и говоримо).

Предимства

new_jobs.description:
About the Job

PhyxUp Health is looking for a Business Operations Manager to help manage and improve our day-to-day business operations across Korea and the U.S.

PhyxUp Health is a San Francisco–headquartered AI healthtech startup building an AI-powered patient care and reimbursement platform for rehabilitation providers in the U.S. Our Korea team works closely with our U.S. operations to build and scale the product.

We are already working with hospitals and clinics across the U.S., and our ARR has grown more than 10x over the past 12 months.

About PhyxUp Health

We believe some of the most important parts of healthcare happen between visits.

Patients spend far more time at home than they do in the clinic, but providers have limited visibility into what happens after the patient leaves. At the same time, clinicians spend significant time on documentation, administrative work, and reimbursement.

PhyxUp uses AI to connect the clinical visit with ongoing care. We help patients stay engaged with their treatment at home while automating repetitive clinical and reimbursement workflows for providers.

We’re not just building another healthcare software tool. We’re building the infrastructure for how care continues after the visit.

About the Role

The Business Operations Manager will help keep PhyxUp's business running smoothly as we grow across Korea and the U.S.

You'll work closely with the CEO and our U.S. team to coordinate daily operations, support our clinical and billing teams, manage administrative processes, and keep important projects moving forward.

This is a hands-on role that involves a wide range of responsibilities, from coordinating with U.S. team members and managing operational documents to supporting government programs, finance, HR, and internal projects.

As the company grows, you'll also help improve existing processes and build more efficient systems that allow our team to scale.

Your main responsibility is to make sure our day-to-day operations run smoothly and help build the systems we need as we grow.

What You'll Do

Coordinate daily operations across our Korea and U.S. teams
Support operational workflows involving our U.S. clinical team, billing team, and clinic partners
Manage internal schedules, email communication, follow-ups, and administrative tasks
Prepare and manage contracts, reports, operational documents, and company records
Coordinate applications, reporting, and administrative requirements for government support programs
Support HR and finance operations, including recruitment coordination, expense tracking, and administrative documentation
Assist with investor materials, business proposals, presentations, and due diligence documents
Track ongoing operational tasks and projects to ensure deadlines are met
Identify inefficiencies in daily operations and help develop better processes
Support the CEO and leadership team with other business operations tasks as needed

How We Work

We are an early-stage startup, which means roles are broad and individual impact is high.

Our operations span two countries and involve clinical teams, billing, customers, and external partners. Clear communication, attention to detail, and reliable execution are essential to keeping everything running smoothly.

We value people who take ownership of their work, follow through on commitments, and look for ways to improve how things are done.

We move quickly, but we don't use speed as an excuse for low-quality work. Our product is used by real healthcare providers and patients every day, so details matter.

You don't need to have all the answers from day one. But you should be willing to learn, take initiative, and become someone the team can rely on as the company grows.

What We're Looking For

Fluent in Korean and English, both written and verbal
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
Able to manage multiple tasks and prioritize work independently
Clear and professional communication with internal teams and external partners
Comfortable working with colleagues and partners in the U.S.

Experience in Business Operations, Administration, Executive Assistance, or a similar role

Experience supporting HR, finance, or billing operations
Experience preparing business reports, presentations, or investor materials
Experience with Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, and similar collaboration tools
Interest in AI, digital health, or the U.S. healthcare industry
Prior startup experience is not required. We value people who are organized, willing to learn, and able to take ownership of their work.

Why Join PhyxUp Health

Work closely with the CEO and leadership team of a growing AI healthtech startup
Gain hands-on experience in both Korean and U.S. business operations
Work with U.S. healthcare organizations and international partners
Gain exposure to clinical operations, billing, finance, HR, and startup management

Ben jij een ervaren projectmanager die impact wil maken binnen een snelgroeiend softwarebedrijf? Wil jij het verschil maken bij klanten op het gebied van personeelsplanning en personeelskrapte? Wil jij jouw ervaring inzetten om het team te versterken en samen optimale resultaten te behalen? Dan kijken we ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten!
Werken bij een van de Top 3 spelers in Workforce management in Nederland en bijdragen aan snelle ontwikkeling in het buitenland?

Bij Intus helpen wij onze klanten en hun medewerkers met slimmer plannen. Hierdoor dragen we bij aan het oplossen van één van de belangrijkste maatschappelijke uitdagingen: personeelskrapte.
Onze producten brengen flexibiliteit en efficiëntie in het planningsproces en dat is fijn voor iedereen. Onze klanten kunnen onze medewerkers optimaal inzetten, terwijl we tegelijkertijd bijdragen aan meer werkgeluk en een gezonde werk-privé balans. Een win-win voor iedereen!

Als projectmanager
bij Intus speel je een cruciale rol in projecten bij onze diverse klanten in verschillende markten zoals zorg, overheid, industrie en logistiek
. Je structureert en realiseert meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd van begin tot het eind. Dit kan gaan om het begeleiden van onze klanten bij het volledig implementeren van onze software InPlanning bij een nieuwe klant of het begeleiden van een complexe transformatie in het applicatielandschap bij een bestaande klant. Ook interne projecten kunnen onderdeel van de werkzaamheden zijn. Dankzij jouw vermogen om draagvlak te creëren en overzicht te behouden, help je klanten en zorg je voor een efficiënt verloop van de projecten.

Je maakt deel uit van een team van projectmanagers en consultants die verantwoordelijk zijn voor alle projecten in Nederland. Als projectmanager ben jij tijdens een project hét aanspreekpunt voor de klant, met betrekking tot de voortgang, planning, kwaliteit, budget en uitvoering. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s (o.a. implementatie consultants en technisch consultants) om de projecten te realiseren, en daarnaast heb je ook regelmatig contact met je collega-projectmanagers, accountmanagers, technisch consultants en product owners. Kortom, een boeiende functie in een dynamische werkomgeving!

Als projectmanager begeleidt je projecten van A tot Z wat betekent dat je de volgende verantwoordelijkheden hebt:

Opstellen van een Plan van Aanpak en een implementatieagenda.
Plannen van projectwerkzaamheden van consultants.
Zorgdragen voor een goede samenwerking tussen alle interne en externe stakeholders van het project.
Tijdig signaleren en rapporteren van risico's, op basis waarvan je een concrete aanpak voorstelt op basis waarvan besluitvorming kan plaatsvinden.
Bewaken van kaders waaronder projectdoelen, kwaliteit, budgetten en planningen.
Verzorgen van maandrapportages en voorbereiding van de facturatie richting de klant.
Overzicht behouden over meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt uitgebreide werkervaring als projectmanager, bij voorkeur in de gezondheidszorg.
Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding.
Je hebt een pro-actieve werkhouding en neemt verantwoordelijkheid.
Je bent een echte teamspeler en weet hoe je effectief stakeholders kunt betrekken.
Je werkt gestructureerd en hebt een helikopterview.
Je bent resultaatgericht, maar verliest de kwaliteit niet uit het oog.
Je bent gedreven, slim, analytisch en bent in staat op verschillende niveaus te denken en te handelen.
Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal op professioneel niveau, mondeling en schriftelijk. Beheers je daarnaast ook nog Duits? Dan is dat de kers op de taart!

Bij Intus hechten we veel waarde aan een informele, maar professionele werksfeer. Maar er is meer dat ons bijzonder maakt! Hier is ons DNA in een kort overzicht:

Trots;
op ons product, onze klanten én onze collega’s!
Goede vibe;
een gezellige sfeer waar iedere mening telt.

jazeker, met korte lijnen en weinig hiërarchie.

w at we tot nu toe hebben gedaan is geweldig, maar we zijn nog lang niet klaar!

Job Description:

Insight Generation & Performance Diagnosis: Analyze campaign and brand performance to uncover trends, drivers, and opportunities across audiences, content, channels, and time.
Develop structured diagnostic deep-dives (e.g., funnel conversion, cohort movement, segment differences, market variance) to explain the “why” behind performance.
Translate analysis into concise insight narratives (what happened, why it happened, implications) with supporting evidence and clear assumptions.
Actionable Recommendations & Optimization: Convert insights into prioritized recommendations with clear levers, expected impact direction, dependencies, and how success will be measured.
Support optimization decisions (targeting, content strategy, channel mix, cadence, audience prioritization) based on observed drivers and constraints.
Propose lightweight forward-looking views (e.g., pacing vs target, scenario comparisons) that improve planning and decision clarity.
KPI Building, Measurement Strategy & Contract Feasibility: Lead KPI framework design for campaigns — define KPI trees, metric definitions, calculation logic, targets/benchmarks, and interpretation guidance.
Assess feasibility of proposed contractual KPIs and deliverables by validating data availability, required instrumentation, methodological soundness, and operational effort.
Recommend feasible KPI alternatives or phased measurement approaches when data limitations exist, ensuring alignment with Docquity's internal insights metrics standards.
Partner with Data & Platform and Product Insights to validate data readiness, resolve definition gaps, and document KPI logic for consistent reuse.
Stakeholder Partnership & Enablement: Provide brand and account managers with insight-ready charts, talking points, and recommendations for client-facing materials (the account/brand team owns final review delivery).
Join working sessions and (as needed) client calls as the insights subject-matter resource to clarify methodology, confidence, and trade-offs.
Standardize and improve recurring insight outputs (templates, metric dictionaries, playbooks) to reduce ambiguity and speed up decision cycles.
Feedback Loop Into a Scalable Product: Identify recurring questions and high-value analyses to productize into scalable modules in partnership with Product Insights.
Lead commercial product creation by translating recurring client and internal insight needs into scalable analytics products, reusable modules, and packaged solution offerings, in close partnership with Product Insights and commercial stakeholders.
Flag data quality issues, missing fields, and pipeline gaps to Data & Platform, and support validation of fixes through reproducible checks.
Contribute to continuous improvement by documenting learnings, best practices, and reusable analyses across brands and markets.

Experience/ Skills Required:

5 years of experience in analytics/BI, performance marketing analytics, commercial strategy analytics, or consulting (healthcare/pharma experience is a plus).
Strong SQL proficiency; comfortable working with large datasets and turning business questions into analysis plans. Experience in Python, R, and other programming languages is a plus.
Experience with visualization and reporting tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar).
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to translate analyses into clear recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience designing KPIs/measurement frameworks; familiarity with experimentation, cohort analysis, and segmentation is advantageous.
Proven track record in commercial product creation and productization, with the ability to shape analytics capabilities into scalable, high-value client-facing and internal commercial solutions.
Strong proficiency in applying AI to business and commercial use cases to elevate analysis, insight generation, workflow automation, and decision support, with sound judgment on data quality, governance, and responsible adoption.
Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment; willingness to collaborate across time zones.

While we have been growing fast, we are still small enough that everyone makes a pivotal difference. We care less about hours worked and more about the outcome — and the impact you make. We have worked hard to create an autonomous working culture emphasizing work/life balance and a fun working environment. We follow the hybrid work culture.
